stem.text: Which pair of enthalpy changes will **always** share the same sign (i.e. both are always exothermic or both are always endothermic)?

A.text: enthalpy change of atomisation and enthalpy change of neutralisation

B.text: enthalpy change of atomisation and enthalpy change of solution

C.text: enthalpy change of combustion and enthalpy change of hydration

D.text: enthalpy change of solution and enthalpy change of hydration
